# Moon Arc Works

> Moon Arc Works is an independent studio that makes mobile apps and games for iPhone and Android, each written for 34 languages. Its first app is Exhale (Dumansız in Turkish), a quit smoking and vaping app, launching on the App Store and Google Play on 7 December 2026. Its first game, Fluffytail: Squirrel Adventure, a 3D platformer for kids aged 6 to 8, is coming soon.

## Exhale: quit smoking and vaping

Exhale helps people quit cigarettes and vapes: a smoke-free counter, money saved at real pack prices for 101 countries, a 30-day quit plan, a 3-minute craving rescue, a health recovery timeline and badges. It needs no account (data stays on the phone) and is free with ads; Exhale Plus removes ads and opens the full 30-day program.

- [Exhale (English)](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/): the app, the savings calculator and FAQ
- [Exhale in all 34 languages](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/): pick a language
- [Dumansız (Türkçe)](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/tr/)

## Cost of smoking by country

The typical price of a pack of 20 cigarettes in 101 countries, and what a pack or half a pack a day costs per month, year and decade. Prices are the app's own feed, updated when taxes change.

- [Cigarette prices by country](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/cost-of-smoking/)
- Country pages follow the pattern https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/cost-of-smoking/<country>/ (for example [Germany](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/cost-of-smoking/germany/), [Japan](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/cost-of-smoking/japan/), [Türkiye](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/en/cost-of-smoking/turkiye/))
- Price data, free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 (credit Exhale by Moon Arc Works): [CSV](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/data/cigarette-prices.csv), [JSON](https://moonarcworks.com/exhale-site/prices.json)

## Fluffytail: Squirrel Adventure

A 3D platformer for kids aged 6 to 8 (Fluffytail: Sincap Macerası in Turkish): a little squirrel runs, climbs and glides through five worlds, all the way to the Moon, to bring little Peanut, stolen away by a fox, back home. No ads, no tracking, no accounts, no chat; it works offline and collects no personal data. The first two chapters are free; one optional purchase, behind a grown-up question, unlocks the Full Adventure. iPhone, iPad and Android, 34 languages. Coming soon.

- [Fluffytail (English)](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/)
- [Fluffytail: Sincap Macerası (Türkçe)](https://moonarcworks.com/tr/fluffytail/)
- [Privacy policy](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/privacy/)
- [Support and FAQ for parents](https://moonarcworks.com/fluffytail/support/)
